title: InteractionKit: Typed Specifications for AI Interaction Experiments
oneLiner: Typed, composable specifications for uncertainty-aware AI interaction experiments and structured behavioral data.
keyTakeaways: InteractionKit defines typed PatternSpec objects for research-oriented AI interaction components.
The v1.0.0 release candidate implements ConfidenceDisplay, RelianceDecision, and OutcomeFeedback primitives, plus composition, JSON Schema generation, and structured event logging.
The release payload passed seven Pattern System contract tests, TypeScript checking, a production build, and clean-install reproduction checks.

The artifact establishes a software specification and local implementation only. It has no participant data and does not establish construct validity, behavioral equivalence, or cross-lab reproducibility.
hciRelevance: Makes uncertainty communication and reliance measurement explicit, typed experimental objects that can be audited before behavioral studies are run.

faq.q: What does the Pattern System cover?
faq.a: PatternSpec defines typed research-oriented objects. The current primitives are ConfidenceDisplay, RelianceDecision, and OutcomeFeedback; compositions generate structured schemas and behavioral events.

faq.q: How does this differ from experiment presentation frameworks?
faq.a: Frameworks such as jsPsych and lab.js focus on presentation and timing. InteractionKit focuses on typed interaction specifications, composition, and output contracts. Complementarity and interoperability have not yet been empirically evaluated.

faq.q: What is the current evidence boundary?
faq.a: The v1.0.0 release candidate is locally and clean-install verified as a software artifact. No public release tag or participant dataset is currently claimed.
